_description: Sample: Push-to-talk (PTT) mode with cascaded (non-realtime) model. EXPERIMENTAL — PTT is not fully supported by the Voice Live platform. See _known_limitations.
_rationale: Cascaded PTT mode for scenarios where the client controls speech boundaries with a non-realtime model (GPT-5, GPT-4.1). EOU is disabled. Server VAD is used with extended silence timeout as workaround for the lack of turn_detection=None support.
_status: Experimental — not validated for production use
_known_limitations: turn_detection=None is not supported by VoiceLive; a VAD config is always required
VAD and PTT can interfere, resulting in reduced audio response rate compared to pure VAD mode
These settings have not been validated by Voice Live engineering — treat as best-effort
PTT with cascaded models may have higher latency due to STT+LLM+TTS pipeline
